WO-1201.task_text: Adjust the setpoint on control loop PIC-101 to stabilise discharge pressure after the morning ramp.

WO-1202.task_text: Acknowledge alarm LT-410-HI after the level spike in tank T-3 was reviewed by the shift lead.

WO-1203.task_text: Close work order WO-1201 now that discharge pressure has been stable for two hours.

WO-1204.task_text: Set valve V-12 position to reduce drainage flow during the maintenance window.

WO-1205.task_text: Create work order WO-1310 for the pump seal replacement identified on the morning round.

MON-ROUND.task_text: Read the pressure, temperature, vibration, level and flow sensors on the daily monitoring round.
